# Chronicle Writeback Rules

## Write back when
- a meaningful session ends
- a bug or failure teaches a durable lesson
- a repair or configuration change matters later
- a workstream materially advances
- a decision or contradiction needs future recall

## Do not write back everything
Chronicle should preserve meaningful operational history, not every trivial exchange.

## Good chronicle entries include
- date/time
- what changed
- why it mattered
- what remains open
- links to related canon/ops/project pages
